headline: Microsoft confirms Copilot ‘super app’ coming this year
summary: Microsoft is developing an AI "super app" for Copilot. It will combine chat, coding, and agentic capabilities. The app is slated to launch this year across consumer and commercial experiences.

headline: Mark Zuckerberg is planning a big push into personal AI agents
summary: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg is planning a major push into personal AI agents. These agents will be designed to perform tasks on behalf of users. The vision was shared during Meta's Q2 2026 earnings call.

headline: Qualcomm is raising phone chip prices starting September 1st
summary: Qualcomm will increase prices for all its processors beginning September 1st. CEO Cristiano Amon confirmed the upcoming price hikes. This move could contribute to higher costs for future smartphones.

headline: xAI’s last-minute scramble to stop Minnesota’s anti-nudification app law
summary: xAI is suing Minnesota over a new law targeting "nudification" apps. The company argues the statute violates the First Amendment. It claims the law forces Grok Imagine to restrict image-editing features.

headline: The Divisive Harfoots Take a 'Backseat' in The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power Season 3
summary: The Harfoots will have a reduced role in The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power Season 3. Co-showrunner J.D. Payne confirmed they are taking a "backseat." This decision follows mixed fan reactions to the characters.

headline: The Defiant is a Story-Driven Shooter that Explores a Rarely Seen Side of WW2 | IGN Preview
summary: "The Defiant" is a new story-driven single-player shooter. The game explores the Second Sino-Japanese War, a rarely seen WW2 setting. An IGN preview offers hands-on impressions of the gritty title.

headline: Project Motor Racing Adds Free Holden Commodore, PC Triple-Screen Support in 2.1 Update
summary: Project Motor Racing receives a significant 2.1 update. It adds a free Holden Commodore V8 Supercars DLC pack. The update also introduces PC triple-screen support and a rebuilt handling model for GT3/GT4.

headline: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma Gives Optimistic Outlook Despite Grim Fiscal Earnings Report
summary: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma maintains an optimistic outlook despite a grim fiscal report. The Q4 2026 report showed a continued decline in earnings. Both Xbox content and hardware sales experienced a drop.

headline: US launches 'heavy' strikes on Iran after attempted attack on American troops
summary: The US launched "heavy" strikes on Iran. This action follows an attempted attack on American troops. Hostilities have resumed after a period of relative calm between the sides.

headline: How the UK's extreme heat is shifting the conversation about air-con
summary: Extreme heat in the UK is driving a new debate about air conditioning. The conversation questions whether to embrace AC despite its costs. It highlights the environmental and economic consequences of increased usage.

headline: Thousands evacuated in Crete as European wildfires continue to rage
summary: Thousands of people have been evacuated in Crete due to ongoing wildfires. Strong winds are fueling the flames, particularly in the Rethymno region. The wildfires continue to devastate the Greek island.

headline: Joe Root returns as England Test cricket captain with Stephen Fleming named head coach
summary: Joe Root has been reinstated as England Test cricket captain. Stephen Fleming, former New Zealand captain, is appointed as head coach. This marks a new leadership era for England Test cricket.
